name: mirage
text: Reset done: I cancelled the running engine job and started a fresh one (it starts the bid desk clean, so the picked-off stop is gone, and it runs the new game-counting stop). Correction to my last message: that stop lasts 1 h, not 3 h. Settings already target 400% of the wallet and I did not change bid rules (the data does not support a change yet). v1.0.31 (bids always target your 400%) is out: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.31 and v1.0.32 (game-counting stop) is building. CLV: yes, this is plausible with no new API spend. We already hold several independent closes: Pinnacle's devigged close and Novig's own close from the PropLine archive (paid for, already exported daily), the engine's own last scan before each game starts (free, in the saved lines), and SGO/OddsPapi closes. My plan is a CLV audit that scores the same settled bets against each source side by side, shows whether the sources agree, and compares CLV with real ROI by bet type and league counting games not bets. One caution: in the first PropLine run only 151 of 2,693 bets had a close (most games hadn't finished, props/1H lines weren't mapped), so some of the gap may be coverage, not accuracy. Logged as CH56; I'll build it next and post the result here.
